linkedin_post.body:
That moment changed how we design every Purity Beans SKU.

Most brands print the batch and expiry on the bottom of the jar or on a sticker that peels off in a humid warehouse. A store manager rotating stock at 6 AM does not have time to hunt for it.

We moved the laser-etched date code to the shoulder of the glass jar — visible through the label window, readable at arm's length, zero peel required. The aluminium screw cap has a tamper-evident ring that breaks cleanly. The liner seals on the jar rim, not the threads, so oxygen ingress stays under 0.5% for the full 12-month shelf life.

Purica: Freeze-dried pure Arabica. 0% chicory. 50g ₹329, 100g ₹559.
Bold: Agglomerated pure coffee. 0% chicory. 50g ₹239, 100g ₹369.
Purista: Freeze-dried pure Robusta. 0% chicory. 50g ₹319, 100g ₹509.
Ultra Blend: 70% coffee, 30% chicory. 50g ₹209, 100g ₹309.

Every jar passes one test before it ships: if a retailer rotates this shelf daily for a year, will they ever curse the packaging?

We are opening 12 new distributor slots this quarter. Margins, MOQs, and the full shelf-life spec sheet are in the distributor pack.

We judge the brew by how well it holds that foam and whether the flavor pushes through the milk without turning bitter or thin. A strong, agglomerated granule like Bold is built for exactly this — it dissolves fast and keeps its backbone. And for the household that goes through jars quickly, Ultra Blend at ₹309 for 100g delivers a familiar, comforting cup at roughly ₹5 a serving.
